text: opril is an ACE inhibitor (p.1193) that is used in the man- agement of hypertension (p.1171) and myocardial infarction (p.1175). It owes its activity to the active metabolite zofenoprilat (SQ-26333) to which it is converted after oral doses. It is given orally in a usual daily maintenance dose of 30 to 60 mg of the calcium salt, as a single dose or in two divided doses. ◊ References. 1. Ambrosioni E, et al.
